findings.evidence: 0/16 decoded evaluations were eligible; never-passed gates: first_pass/schema_exact_match max=0.893 < 0.950.
findings.implication: No task-selected grounding checkpoint was saved; deployment falls back to token-loss selection.
findings.recommendation: Tune gates from an explicit pre-run acceptance policy or always retain the best observed decoded checkpoint separately.

findings.evidence: Best observed decoded step=3000; final-minus-best metrics={'contact_f1': -0.10303030303030303, 'strongest_joint_accuracy': -0.3125, 'affected_joints_set_f1': -0.15401635401635394, 'onset_within_50ms': -0.13333333333333341}.
findings.implication: Continuing training improved token likelihood while degrading operator-facing answers.
findings.recommendation: Select checkpoints using predeclared decoded validation metrics and confirm once on unused recording groups.

findings.evidence: Only 71.4% of final validation outputs contained a parseable Rationale section.
findings.implication: The conversational observability contract is not consistently satisfied even when JSON parses.
findings.recommendation: Report rationale coverage separately and reject or visibly label missing rationales in the demo.

findings.evidence: First-pass schema=0.798, post-retry schema=0.905, retry rate=0.143.
findings.implication: A second decode improves reporting metrics but increases latency and hides unreliable first responses.
findings.recommendation: Treat first-pass validity as the deployment metric; add constrained decoding or stronger schema supervision.

findings.evidence: Final panel has no strongest-joint targets for J3, J6, J7.
findings.implication: Aggregate joint accuracy cannot characterize these joints under natural prevalence.
findings.recommendation: Keep natural-prevalence headline metrics, but add a separate diagnostic joint-coverage panel without training rebalancing.

findings.evidence: Immutable hypothesis says 'focused_three_intent_curriculum_without_channel_permutation', while curriculum_intents='all' and receipts contain 7 intents.
findings.implication: A headline metadata field misdescribes the experiment even though detailed receipt fields are correct.
findings.recommendation: Use the detailed intent counts as authoritative and validate hypothesis labels against materialized views before launch.

findings.evidence: The training run directory contains validation/probe receipts but no test prediction receipt.
findings.implication: This run supports model selection analysis, not a new held-out performance claim.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate the frozen checkpoint once on unused recording groups; do not tune after inspecting them.

findings.evidence: The same 84-row panel was decoded 16 times; smallest intent slice n=12.
findings.implication: Checkpoint rankings are noisy and repeated inspection can overfit decisions to this panel.
findings.recommendation: Use it for monitoring only, then confirm the frozen choice on new recording groups with session-level intervals.

findings.implication: The model remains capacity/optimization limited on exact training prompts; validation errors are not purely overfit.
findings.recommendation: Inspect prompt-family losses and output-token allocation before adding epochs.

methodology_limits: Validation was repeatedly inspected during training and is not an untouched confirmation set.
The 84-row generation panel is useful for observability but too small for stable rare-slice claims.
Strongest-joint, affected-joint, and evidence-interval targets measure agreement with deterministic signal rules, not physical impact location.
Zeroing all channels is a coarse dependence check; it does not prove temporal or channel-grounded reasoning.
Rationale lexical checks do not prove faithful reasoning.

report_contract.scope: completed-run validation methodology audit; not a test-set score or safety claim
